scientific_integrity: The projection forward kernel and identification of two preferred axis-ratio levels are acknowledged as classical (1981); the distinct proposed contribution is the sharp logarithmic coefficients and explicit three-statistic inverse classification, with a strict ambiguity-breaking factor. Numerical checks are supporting diagnostics only.
scientific_limitations: Single, strictly triaxial Euclidean ellipsoid; independent Haar-uniform viewing directions; noiseless population projection aspect-ratio density. No finite-sample inversion, mixture identifiability, or uniformity at coincident semiaxes. Historical priority of explicit singularity coefficients/inversion is not independently certified.
title: Two logarithmic caustics and three-statistic recovery from random ellipsoid shadows
